description: 「高齢者施設等における防災マニュアル策定ガイドライン ~水・食料・医薬品等の確保を中心に~ 」 を作成しました_3 高齢者施設等における災害対策の現状と課題(6~12ページ)(PDF:1,516KB) [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京都保健医療局. Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 東京都保健医療局. It offers 6 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
